name: orion
description: Orion: a personal design language on Material 3 Expressive, with a glass layer for floating chrome.

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && node scripts/build-gray.mjs && npm run build:icons && npm run build:bundle
scripts.check: npm run check:tokens && npm run check:gray && npm run check:icons && npm run check:glass && npm run check:accent && npm run check:scopes && npm run check:motion && npm run check:words && npm run check:clipboard && npm run check:bundle && npm run check:api
scripts.test: npm run test:suite && npm run test:pages && npm run test:reach && npm run test:layout && npm run test:checker && npm run test:back && npm run test:lean && npm run test:upgrade && npm run test:network
